verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer's ChatGD lets the firm's own attorneys query and manipulate documents in natural language, using an enterprise OpenAI instance on Azure with RAG over supplied agreements. However, it is an internal tool, and the client-facing platforms (Contract Generator, GDHQ, SMART Request forms, Catalyze) are not shown to accept natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of client-facing tools, evidence that external users can access ChatGD, documentation of command scope and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
